deadline.value: Positions are advertised through open calls on the DTU job database.
deadline.quote: All positions are advertised through open calls, available through the DTU job database

also.quote: The PhD program at DTU Bioengineering is an internationally oriented comprehensive research education within the department’s research fields; biotechnology and biomedicine.

supervisor.value: The PhD committee assesses the choice of supervisors as part of admission.
supervisor.quote: In connection with admission, the PhD committee further assesses the individual PhD programme and the choice of supervisors.

also.quote: All PhD students at DTU Bioengineering have a principal supervisor and at least one co-supervisor.

funding.value: Admission requires a funding plan covering all three years, and the PhD school must ensure the funds are there.
funding.quote: The PhD school must ensure that funds are available for the duration of the study programme and that the funding plan covers all three years.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an education equivalent to a Master's degree in a relevant research field.
entry_route.quote: you have to have an educational background with an academic level equivalent to a master's degree in a relevant research field

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: The PhD programme covers biotechnology and biomedicine; the PhD scholarship route is described on the department page.
